text_block_list.name: Candy Shop Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both so much.
I really appreciate you helping my son and his wife move.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine, really.
Grandma takes care of me all the time anyway."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I thought it'd take past noon,
but having the two of us made quick work of it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, we butt heads a lot, sure.
But teaming up like this ain't so bad either.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Well, if it was always like this,
it'd throw off my rhythm, though.

text_block_list.name: Candy Shop Old Lady
text_block_list.text: Oh, right. There should be some ohagi left, so make sure you two eat some before heading home.

text_block_list.name: Candy Shop Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my, are there only three left?
I just had some this morning, so you two go ahead and split them nicely.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Then you take two of them, Vodka.
You must be tired from carrying that dresser and all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "No, no, you were the one carrying a fridge! You should take it."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's really nothing.
You're the one who must be tired.
You let out a big "phew~" after carrying it, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Then what about you? You were the one pumping yourself up with that whole "Aaaand heave-ho!" thing!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"That was obviously just a battle cry!
No matter how you look at it, 'phew' is the sound you make when you catch your breath after doing heavy lifting!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Quit nagging over every little thing!
I ain't gonna get tired from just that!
Just take it already!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm not tired in the slightest either!
Vodka, you take it!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Grrrrrrrrgh...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Staring each other down won't get us anywhere!
How 'bout a contest to see who's less tired?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fine by me! In that case,
how about a race around the neighborhood!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on! The goal is right here!
Whoever's more exhausted gets the leftover ohagi!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Shaaaaaaaa!!!!

text_block_list.name: Candy Shop Old Lady
text_block_list.text: ...Oh my. Full of energy, aren't they?
